meta.name: adversarial-persona
meta.description: Strategy: Role-play attacks from hostile personas — competing lab researcher, hostile reviewer, funding skeptic, domain outsider — each with distinct attack motivations and blind spots.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 模拟敌对角色攻击你的项目，发现盲点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目早期识别安全与逻辑漏洞
copy.tagline_en: Simulate hostile persona attacks to uncover blind spots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to identify security and logic flaws early in your project

howto.what: Claude 会扮演多个敌对角色（如竞争实验室研究员、苛刻评审、资金审查官、领域外行人），从不同动机和盲点出发，对你的内容进行结构化攻击测试，并汇总发现。
howto.when: 当你要求对某个工件（如论文、项目方案）进行对抗性测试、压力评审或找出潜在弱点时触发。

say.text: 请以敌对评审的身份审查我的论文，找出统计方法上的漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会从方法论严谨性角度发起攻击。

say.text: 扮演一个竞争实验室的研究员，质疑我的方案创新性。
say.note: Claude 会从优先权争议和替代方案角度质疑。

say.text: 作为资金审查官，评估我的项目可行性。
say.note: Claude 会聚焦影响声明、可行性和时间线现实性。

howto.what_en: Claude role-plays multiple hostile personas (e.g., competing lab researcher, hostile reviewer, funding skeptic, domain outsider) to attack your artifact from distinct motivational frames and blind spots, then aggregates findings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for adversarial testing, stress review, or vulnerability identification on an artifact like a paper or project proposal.

say_en.text: Review my paper as a hostile reviewer, focusing on statistical validity flaws.
say_en.note: Claude attacks from methodological rigor and novelty claims.

say_en.text: Act as a competing lab researcher questioning my approach's novelty.
say_en.note: Claude challenges priority and alternative methods.

say_en.text: Evaluate my project feasibility as a funding skeptic.
say_en.note: Claude probes impact claims, timeline, and realism.
